title: Cause-of-Loss Weighting of the LandlordGuard Renewal Claims Load
content:
Pricing memorandum for the LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal: the claims load is weighted by the cause of loss of the claim with the most recent loss date on the policy.

**Weighting rule.**

- When that cause was sudden and accidental water (recorded as water sudden accidental) or freeze — losses that follow upkeep — the claims load is multiplied by 1.5.
- When it was wind/hail, lightning or weight of ice and snow — losses that follow the weather — the claims load is multiplied by 0.5.
- For any other cause the claims load is taken as it stands.

The claim that decides the weight is the one with the latest date of loss among all claims reported on the policy, whether or not it falls inside the claims lookback.

| Cause of loss of the most recent claim | Weight on the claims load |
|---|---|
| sudden and accidental water, freeze | 1.5 |
| wind/hail, lightning, weight of ice and snow | 0.5 |
| any other cause, or no claim on the policy | 1 |

## Worked weights (hypothetical claims loads)

| Claims load before weighting | Most recent cause | Claims load after weighting |
|---|---|---|
| 20 percent | freeze | 30 percent |
| 10 percent | sudden and accidental water | 15 percent |
| 20 percent | wind/hail | 10 percent |
| 10 percent | fire | 10 percent |
| 0 percent | freeze | 0 percent |
